baseUrl.label: InfiniMind Base URL

apiKey.label: InfiniMind API Key
apiKey.help: Bearer token used to authenticate bridge requests

defaultScope.label: Default Scope
defaultScope.help: Default recall scope when not provided in tool params

includeSensitiveDefault.label: Include Sensitive by Default
includeSensitiveDefault.help: If enabled, bridge requests can ask for sensitive memories by default

identityFallback.help: Controls behavior when user identity is missing from tool input
